sv.title: Minst 400 miljarder uppges kapas i ny EU-budget
sv.summary: Ytterligare minst 400 miljarder kronor uppges ha kapats i nästa kompromissbud om EU:s långtidsbudget.

en.title: At least 400 billion reportedly cut from new EU budget
en.summary: At least another 400 billion kronor reportedly has been cut in the next compromise proposal on the EU's long-term budget.
